occurrences.checkable_against: Trimbos Institute warning or red alert on Trump-shaped ecstasy pills

occurrences.checkable_against: Photograph or seized-pill evidence documenting the pill markings

occurrences.subject: Trimbos Institute

occurrences.checkable_against: Trimbos Institute red alert and laboratory analysis of the pills
occurrences.quote_span: The Trimbos Institute warned in a "red alert" that the pills contain a high concentration of PMMA, also known as para-methoxymethamphetamine, which is similar to ecstasy’s active ingredient MDMA but is slower acting.
occurrences.speaker: Trimbos Institute
occurrences.subject: Trimbos Institute

occurrences.checkable_against: Trimbos Institute photograph of the pills and image metadata
occurrences.quote_span: The institute shared a photo of two of the pills, one of which was green on the front and the other yellow. They were red and blue on the back.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News
occurrences.subject: Trimbos Institute

evidence.title: Dutch institute warns of Trump-shaped ecstasy pills

occurrences.checkable_against: Trimbos Institute Red Alert and pharmacological/toxicology evidence
occurrences.quote_span: However, PMMA is slower working than MDMA and that could lead users to take more because they think that the first pill didn’t work, leading to a risk of overdosing, the institute said, adding that use of the pills “can lead to overheating with possibly deadly consequences.”

occurrences.subject: Trimbos Institute

occurrences.checkable_against: Trimbos Institute Red Alert
occurrences.quote_span: “Absolutely do not use these pills,” the institute warned.

occurrences.checkable_against: Trimbos Institute warning and public statements dated August 28, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: A Dutch drug addiction and mental health institute warned users on Friday about potentially lethal ecstasy pills shaped to look like the head of U.S. President Donald Trump.
occurrences.speaker: Trimbos Institute
occurrences.subject: Trimbos Institute

occurrences.checkable_against: Trimbos Institute incident reports and Dutch health surveillance records
occurrences.quote_span: Spokesperson Anniek Groothuis said that the institute has no reported cases of serious illness or fatalities among people who may have used the drug.
occurrences.speaker: Anniek Groothuis
occurrences.subject: Trimbos Institute

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch toxicology and medical examiner records
occurrences.quote_span: “We do not know of any victims where PMMA was found in their blood,” she told The Associated Press.

occurrences.subject: Trimbos Institute

occurrences.checkable_against: Drug-testing center intake records and Trimbos Institute statement
occurrences.quote_span: The respected Trimbos Institute said that several of the pills have been handed in recently at a network of centers that test drugs for users before they take them.
occurrences.speaker: Trimbos Institute
occurrences.subject: Trimbos Institute

occurrences.checkable_against: Trimbos Institute Red Alert and laboratory testing results
occurrences.quote_span: The institute warned in a “ Red Alert ” published on its website and social media that they contain a high concentration of a chemical called PMMA, or para-methoxymethamfetamine, that is similar to MDMA, the active ingredient in ecstasy pills.
occurrences.speaker: Trimbos Institute
occurrences.subject: Trimbos Institute

occurrences.checkable_against: Photographs released by Trimbos Institute
occurrences.quote_span: It released a photo of the pills that have a depiction of Trump’s head on one side and on the other side “NL” and “Trump” stamped into the surface either side of a vertical line.

occurrences.subject: Trimbos Institute

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch criminal law and national drug-use prevalence surveys
